description_en: Query the permissions of a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
name: DescribeUserPermissions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the RAM user that you want to query
parameters.name: user_id

Permissions.description_en: The details about the permissions of the RAM user

items.description_en: The details about the permissions of the RAM user

ResourceId.description_en:
The authorization setting. Valid values:

{cluster_id} is returned if the permissions are scoped to a cluster.
{cluster_id}/{namespace} is returned if the permissions are scoped to a namespace of a cluster.
all-clusters is returned if the permissions are scoped to all clusters
ResourceId.description_zh:
主控实例访问配置，格式为：
当是集群维度授权时，格式为：{cluster_id}。
当是命名空间维度授权时，格式为：{cluster_id}/{namespace}。
当是所有集群授权时，值固定为：all-clusters

ResourceType.description_en:
The authorization type. Valid values:

cluster: indicates that the permissions are scoped to a cluster.
namespace: indicates that the permissions are scoped to a namespace of a cluster
ResourceType.description_zh:
授权类型，取值：
cluster：集群维度。
namespace：命名空间维度

RoleName.description_en: The name of the custom role. If a custom role is assigned, the value is the name of the assigned custom role
RoleName.description_zh: 自定义角色名称，当授权自定义角色时，该字段为指定的自定义主控实例管理角色名称

RoleType.description_en:
The type of predefined role. Valid values:

admin: administrator
dev: developer
RoleType.description_zh:
预置的角色类型，取值：

admin：管理员。
dev：开发人员
